findings: Case status currently transitions only CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED/SOURCING on Patch. RECOMMENDATION_READY and NO_ELIGIBLE_SUPPLIER are enum values, not persisted by Search/Finalize.
RFQ readiness must use same-run successful Finalize bound to current Case version; never treat the enum alone as approval.
ERP prompt requires supplier/history/performance reads before Patch: preserve these during initial analysis.
MCP read annotations exist at server but are not copied to readOnly metadata in registry; do not change Phase 4 projection/dedup indirectly by adding readOnly flags.
